name: landmine-rotation
instructions:
1. Assume an athletic position with your feet slightly wider than shoulder width and position a barbell in a landmine attachment.
2. Grasp the end of the barbell by your side with both hands overlapping.
3. Rotate your shoulders and keep the arms locked out while allowing the end of the barbell to rotate around your body.
4. Repeat in the opposite direction for the desired number of repetitions.
